data.name: Violent Sky
data.detailed_description:
Violent Sky is an open-world storm chasing and severe weather simulation game where forecasting, preparation, and survival are just as important as getting the perfect view of the storm.

Explore a large, varied environment filled with urban neighborhoods, suburban communities, open plains, and remote rural roads. Study changing weather conditions, track developing storm systems, and decide where to position yourself before dangerous weather arrives.

Chase storms as they form and move across the map, document severe weather, and gather information while staying alert to rapidly changing conditions. A promising setup can quickly become life-threatening as heavy rain, strong winds, hail, flooding, and tornadoes impact the world around you.

Your goal is not simply to find the storm—it is to understand it, safely get close enough to observe it, and make it back before the weather overwhelms you.

  • Dynamic Severe Weather – Watch storms develop, strengthen, move, and affect different parts of the map.

  • Storm Forecasting – Study weather conditions and determine where severe storms are most likely to form.

  • Open-World Storm Chasing – Travel through cities, suburbs, farmland, rural communities, and wide-open plains.

  • Document Dangerous Weather – Capture storms and severe weather events while searching for the best and safest position.

  • Survival and Preparation – Manage the risks of poor visibility, damaging winds, flooding, debris, and rapidly changing storm paths.

  • Atmospheric Exploration – Experience calm weather, distant storm development, darkening skies, and the tension of an approaching tornado.

Every storm tells a different story. Read the sky, choose your route, and face the Violent Sky.

data.short_description: Chase, forecast, and document powerful storms in an open world of cities, suburbs, rural communities, and open plains. Track developing weather, capture dangerous events, and survive tornadoes, hail, and destructive winds.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
